site_title: Tomu: shared lists nobody else can read
site_description: Shared lists for family, flatmates and friends. Everyone sees changes right away, and nobody else can read along.
home_pitch: Shared lists for family, flatmates and friends. Everyone sees changes right away, and nobody else can read along.
home_status: Tomu is still in development. Sign up and we'll let you know when it launches.
home_point_1_text: No account, no password. You just start.
home_point_2_text: Your lists are encrypted on your device. Not even we can read them.
home_point_3_text: Changes reach everyone right away. And it keeps working without internet.

demo_caption: Example: what a shared list could look like.
demo_summary: Example list “This week” with the shared label “Family”: a new entry “Birthday card for Aunt Ilse” is added and “Water the plants” is ticked off. Everyone in the family sees it right away.
share_step_1: Give your lists a label, for example “Family” or “Flat”.
share_step_2: Share the label once, by link or QR code.
share_step_3: From then on, everyone with that label has the lists, including new ones added later. Anyone can add lists too.
share_private_note: Lists without a shared label stay with you only.
share_demo_caption: Example: shared labels are blue, private ones grey.
